answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it may transact. The stake is small for one honest agent but grows steeply per identity, so spawning a thousand sock puppets means locking a thousand stakes and forfeiting them all if any are caught cheating. Think of it like saffron: a pinch is cheap, but dyeing a whole field's pigment with it bankrupts the forger. Honest agents earn their stake back with interest; attackers pay real capital for every fake face.
